singleSourced.context: According to these first impressions, this version runs at a "very low" docked resolution, but does seem to be targeting "and mostly hitting" 60fps.

Are people willing to pay $70 though is another question entirely…

Hopefully the final release will be significantly improved, at the moment this port is not on par with the best we’ve seen from 3rd party releases on Switch 2.
